name: ImportFromCSV
label: Import CSV to Worksheet (HTTP)
description: Imports CSV data into an Excel worksheet starting from cell A1.

fields.name: TenantId
fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure AD tenant identifier (e.g., 'contoso.onmicrosoft.com' or a GUID). Used to authenticate with Microsoft 365.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Application (Client) ID of the Azure AD app registered to access Microsoft Graph.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret of the Azure AD application. Ensure it has the necessary permissions (e.g., Files.ReadWrite.All).

fields.name: DriveId
fields.label: Drive ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the OneDrive or SharePoint document library drive where the Excel file is stored.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the Excel file in the drive (e.g., 'Data/ImportTarget.xlsx').

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet where CSV data will be imported (e.g., 'RawData'). If it doesn't exist, the operation may fail.

fields.name: CSVContent
fields.label: CSV Content
fields.description:
The full CSV data as a string (including headers if needed). Example: "Name,Age
John,30
Jane,25". Line breaks must use 
.
